Scroll #cantiere → cj-section-cantiere mounted → se-section + 5 chips (Tutti gli spazi, Terrazza, Cucina, Living, Bagno padronale, all data-testid present) + 8 entries timeline → first entry visible: '20 MAGGIO 2026 · SOPRALLUOGO · Terrazza · Sopralluogo terrazza · vista finale' + architectural photo with caption mono uppercase 'VISTA TERRAZZA AL TRAMONTO'. Click chip 'Cucina' → exactly 2 entries remain, both with space_label 'Cucina'. Editorial vocabulary on screen confirmed: SITE EVOLUTION™ eyebrow + 'La memoria viva del cantiere' Playfair title + '8 MOMENTI' count gold mono. POST endpoint auto-activates the site_evolution milestone (test_admin_can_post PASS — entry idratato w/ space_label 'Living' + visit_label 'Installazione'). Persistence: entries in journey_timeline_events (event_type='site_evolution' + metadata_json) — no schema migration needed, confirmed by router static read + admin POST round-trip + cleanup.

integration_issues.issue: First navigation to /client lands on the journey list and only after reload bumps to /client/journey/:id. Race condition is benign (already documented by main agent) but real users may see a 1-frame zero-data screen. A waitForSelector on the journeys list before redirecting would smooth it.

action_items: (Optional · UX gap) None of the 8 seeded Villa Riviera momenti carry before_url+after_url, so the BeforeAfter slider — a hero capability of G.8 — is NEVER seen in the live demo. Code is in place (BeforeAfter component + se-baf testids + Prima/Stato attuale labels — all verified by static pytest) but to showcase it on demo, seed at least 1 entry (suggested: 'master_bath demolition→installation' or 'kitchen demolition→moduli posati') with both before_url and after_url populated. Currently se-baf count on live page = 0.

(Optional · housekeeping) Single-journey auto-redirect on /client occasionally needs a reload on first cold load. Consider awaiting journeys list resolution (zero_data===false && journeys.length===1) before issuing navigate(), to avoid the 1-frame zero-data flash.
critical_code_review_comments: site_evolution.py router cleanly separates studio (GET+POST under /api/journeys/{jid}/site-evolution) from client read-only (GET under /api/client/journeys/{jid}/site-evolution). RBAC matrix matches spec exactly: studio GET = super_admin/tenant_admin/designer/pm/editor/advisor (no client); studio POST = same minus advisor (no client/advisor); client GET = role client OWNING the project, with tenant_admin/super_admin bypass for QA. Verified live: client→studio 403, designer→client 403, designer→studio 201.
SiteEvolutionEntryIn pydantic model: space_key, title (2-140), narrative (2-600), visit_kind enum, occurred_at ISO, photos[], before_url, after_url, materials_linked[] — proper input validation.

Persistence pattern (entries in journey_timeline_events with event_type='site_evolution' + JSON metadata) avoids schema migration AND lets the existing _site_evolution_for_step loader in journey_step_workspace.py reuse the same table — clean choice.
Auto-activate milestone site_evolution from not_started→in_progress at first POST is correct (verified by spec test_admin_can_post). 409 path for missing milestone is wired and exercised.

Italian editorial dictionary lives entirely in router constants — 9 visit labels (Sopralluogo, Demolizione, Arrivo materiali, Installazione, Mockup materiali, Visita showroom, Verifica tecnica, Styling, Momento chiave) + 11 space labels (Living, Cucina, Camera padronale, Bagno padronale, Terrazza, Ingresso, Studio, Giardino, Suite 03, Lobby, Spazi comuni) — confirmed by test_router_uses_editorial_italian.

SiteEvolutionSection.jsx is editorially clean: BeforeAfter slider implemented with drag-handle gold + Prima/Stato attuale labels + mouse+touch handlers, filter chips by space (Tutti gli spazi / per-space), data-testid coverage on se-section, se-empty, se-spaces, se-space-{key}, se-timeline, se-entry-{id}, se-photos-{id}, se-photo-{id}-{i}, se-baf, se-baf-handle. Empty state copy 'Il cantiere non è ancora iniziato' present.
ClientSidebar.jsx exposes 'Site Evolution™' with HardHat icon at anchor 'cantiere' in 7th position (penultima prima di Memoria & Archivio) — confirmed by test_sidebar_exposes_site_evolution_section.
ensure_site_evolution() in seed_demo_journey.py is idempotent (keyed on (journey_id, title) uniqueness via journey_timeline_events lookup) — re-running seed produces zero duplicates per spec.

context_for_next_testing_agent: G.8 Site Evolution™ is GREEN: 16/16 G.8 pytest + 155/155 full G.1→G.8 regression + live mobile walkthrough + RBAC matrix verified live. The persistence model is journey_timeline_events.event_type='site_evolution' + metadata_json — no separate table, no schema migration. If a future sprint adds DELETE or PATCH for entries, keep that same table. If the next sprint introduces a SiteEvolutionUpload™ workflow (studio uploads from desktop), MAKE SURE the photos[] schema in SiteEvolutionEntryIn stays {url, caption} dict — the SiteEvolutionSection.jsx renders entry.photos.map and reads url+caption. The BeforeAfter slider code is fully in place (drag handle, mouse+touch handlers, Prima/Stato attuale labels) — but NO seeded entry carries before_url+after_url, so a future demo or sprint should add at least 1 pair to Villa Riviera (suggested: master_bath demolition→installation) so the slider is visible end-to-end without manual data injection. The /client cold-login race (zero-data screen → reload bumps to /journey/:id) persists from iter108; it is documented but not yet fixed.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues. (a) Mobile cold-login race: known transient — the GET /api/client/journeys returns the journey list AFTER the navigate() guard fires, so the first /client render briefly shows zero-data and only the subsequent re-render redirects. A reload solves it instantly. Fix would be to await {zero_data, journeys} before the redirect decision in /client. (b) BeforeAfter slider not visible on live page is a SEED GAP, not a code bug: the slider is wired (static test_component_supports_before_after_slider PASS) but Villa Riviera's 8 seeded momenti don't include a before/after pair. Add one to ensure_site_evolution() (e.g., master_bath: before_url=demolition photo, after_url=installation photo) to demonstrate the slider on the demo client.
